description: Textured Black Felt Pad with Circular Cutout
_comment: Replace mm_per_px with YOUR rig's calibration. Measure a known dimension on a real part, divide by its pixel width.

calibration.recalibrate_if: camera moved, lens changed, or working distance altered

golden_set._comment: Real known-good parts photographed in the rig. NOT edits of one image.

global_tolerances._comment: Exceeding these is a DEFECT, not something to correct for.

detection._comment: review_top_n is what the operator sees. All candidates persist for audit.

severity_rules.CRITICAL: area > 2.0mm2 OR detector_agreement > 0.6 OR color defect > 5mm2
